How these comparisons work

Every degree uses your same private course records. Completed matches stay provisional until the school approves them for that exact degree. In-progress, saved and planned courses are potential matches only.

Remaining costs use published prices or your saved assumptions. Tuition and outside-course estimates are separate from unconfirmed fees; an incomplete subtotal is not a complete degree price. Completed matches are excluded from future course costs. Unresearched requirements use university fallback pricing. Study time appears only when modeled; admissions, approval and record processing can add time.
